problem_solved: Need for configurable high-speed control systems in power electronics applications
description: HSRPEC is a reconfigurable high-speed power electronics controller designed for real-time control and monitoring of power electronic systems. The controller combines conventional embedded architectures with digital signal processing capabilities.

Power electronics and industrial automation companies
Renewable energy, solar inverter, and energy storage system developers
Electric vehicle (EV) powertrain and charging infrastructure manufacturers
Power system research laboratories and engineering institutions
Industrial equipment manufacturers requiring real-time control and monitoring solutions
